basis: S12a: user rulings 2026-10-26 after the S12 error analysis found about 28% of segment errors were Golden or scoring artifacts. (1) Near-identical passages across documents credit each other once 本合同/本条款/本附加合同 and footnote marks are folded, still by exact containment of at least copy_min_chars; numbers with a unit or after 第 never fold. (2) Headings and reader-guide lines of terms and brochures are neutral; rate-table cells are not headings. (3) Brochure restatements are neutral for a field whose Golden cites the terms; footnote blocks and the definitions section are neutral unless the field's card asks for definitions or footnotes.
copy_footnote_pattern: (?<=[一-鿿])(?<!第)(?<!\d)\d{1,2}(?!\d)(?![日天年月周岁元万千百亿倍种次个项级类期份条章节款号%])(?=[一-鿿])
clause_number_pattern: ^\s*(?:第[一二三四五六七八九十百零\d]+[条章节]|\d+(?:\.\d+)+)
chapter_heading_pattern: ^(?:第[一二三四五六七八九十百零\d]+章|\d+[.．、](?!\d))
